run_generate_docs: run the script to generate Sphinx automodule RST files for all public protobuf modules
find_modules: find all public Python modules in the protobuf source directory excluding ignored packages and test modules
write_automodule: write a Sphinx automodule RST file for a given protobuf module with members and inherited members
replace_toc: replace the table of contents section in index.rst with a toctree listing all discovered modules
summarize_generate_docs: summarize the generate_docs script that creates RST reference docs and updates the Sphinx index toctree
